text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Wait a second, I thought Yukino Bijin was racing today?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Yeah, remember how crowded it was at the Oka Sho? This is the same venue, so what gives?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: It's because the "Yukino Boom" is dying down. Just like any other fad, it's come and gone. Last year was an anomaly.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: I wonder if that means people will start rating her abilities more accurately. That must be a relief for her too.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Okey doke!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm back, Hanshiiin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin springs forward as soon as she enters the racecourse, eager to get a feel for today's crowd.
choice_data_list: How does it look out there?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Mmm, it's a bit diff'rent from last year, but I figured as much.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I still remember how gobsmacked I was t'see all those people cheer'n for me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Guess I was a li'l too gobsmacked. I should've used that moment t'show what I got, but I didn't.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: That's why ev'ryone's feelings for me have melted away, just like the snow in spring.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But I get it. This's just what happens with fads!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: That's why I've decided I'm gonna start a new fad t'day!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: If I can get one started based on m'actual skills, I'm sure it'll last.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Back at the Japanese Oaks, I was determined t'win! I ran with everyth'n I had, and I don't wanna betray that feel'n!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Besides, the type of city girl I wanna be wouldn't lose heart here! She'd rush forward, full steam ahead!
choice_data_list: Right. As long as you keep running, your passion will come through.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I think so too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wait a sec… Is that…

text_block_list.name: Harp Alpha
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I'll be all right. Today's going to be okay…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Golly, she's as pale as a ghost. And she's shak'n too…
choice_data_list: Maybe it's because she lost her last race.
Maybe it's because she lost her last race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All eyes were on Harp Alpha during the previous race, yet she didn't even manage to place.
choice_data_list: That's what happens when you're under a lot of pressure.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Looks like she's tak'n it pretty hard…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Back when we were rac'n for the first time, she seemed like the perfect city girl… but I guess no one's perfect.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hmm, well…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I don't think this is worry I'm feel'n. It's more like… frustration?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: She was always so glam'rous when she ran—she was practic'lly shin'n.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Watch'n her made me wanna work hard 'nuff t'beat her. But… I never told her that.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Y'don't think that'd bother her?
choice_data_list: I think she needs to hear it.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Then, I'll be back in two shakes of a lamb's tail!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Um…

text_block_list.name: Harp Alpha
text_block_list.text: …What do you want?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: R-right, this's the first time we've ever talked face to face, huh… Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But I've always been watch'n, even if it was from far away!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I just want you t'know… you're the reason I work so hard!

text_block_list.name: Harp Alpha
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I always thought you were just the bee's knees. I wanted t'be just like you, and I think that gave me courage.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Granted, I haven't gotten the hang of us'n that courage, but I'm no quitter!

text_block_list.name: Harp Alpha
text_block_list.text: …Why are you telling me this?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Um… I guess I thought know'n someone's look'n up t'you might give you courage too.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You're my rival, but… I'm still cheer'n for you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I wanna see you shine like a star again!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: So… let's have a good race t'day!
